changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE krrg_location_states ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uk_location_states__code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE krrg_location_cities ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, state_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uk_location_cities__name_state UNIQUE (name, state_id), CONSTRAINT fk_location_cities__state FOREIGN KEY (state_id) REFERENCES krrg_location_states (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_location_cities__state_id ON krrg_location_cities (state_id);

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE krrg_location_languages ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uk_location_languages__code UNIQUE (code) );

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_location_states ADD CONSTRAINT uk_location_states__code UNIQUE (code);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_location_states DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uk_location_states__code;

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_location_languages ADD CONSTRAINT uk_location_languages__code UNIQUE (code);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_location_languages DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uk_location_languages__code;
